scope: Newly partitioned internal chemical-family benchmark with fresh supervised weights; not an external dataset
primary: Unperturbed test C2 MRR@25: fresh full model minus D1+D2 baseline
secondary: Joint paired bootstrap over all prespecified ablation/control contrasts and C1/C2/C3
test_policy: All rankers, feature lists and model hashes sealed before test feature generation. Test never used for training, stopping or hyperparameter selection.
retrieval_policy: The retrieval corpus may contain evaluation-family references according to the C1 task definition. Per-query C2/C3 exclude metric-equivalent truth references. Query-family disjointness concerns supervised fitting, not a reference-free discovery task.
promotion_policy: Report all outcomes, including failures and negative controls; no automatic model promotion or competition submission
budget: Existing free Kaggle execution only; no hosted inference, paid infrastructure or external LLM calls
